name: Standing Our Ground
label: Quest
description: Standing Our Ground: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.
This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.
On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I... Can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
